spans.s: इनि ( 1 ) kṛt affix इन् applied to the roots क्री with धि, जु with प्र, and the roots जि, दृ, क्षि and others, e. g. सोमविक्रयी, प्रजवी, जयी etc. cf. P.III 2.93 and
-157: (2) tad. affix इन् affixed to the word पाण्डुकम्बल in the sense of 'covered with' ( cf. P,
), in the sense of collec- tion to the word खल e.g. खलिनी cf.
, to the word अनुब्राह्मण in sense 'student of' e.g. अनुब्राह्मणी cf.
, to the words कर्मन्द and कृशाश्च cf. P.
and to the word श्राद्ध cf.
